offering_description.value: Operates a franchise network providing temporary staffing, permanent placement and executive recruitment to employers.

primary_services.value: Temporary staffing; direct-hire recruitment; executive search; staffing franchise support

customer_segment.value: B2B: Employers seeking temporary workers or permanent hires, staffing franchise operators

end_markets.value: Construction; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; hospitality; office administration; professional employment

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: Franchise operators pay royalties for staffing brands and operating systems; service fees: Employer payments for temporary staffing and successful permanent placements support the franchise network

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Connects workers with employers through franchised staffing and recruitment offices and supplies operating support to franchisees

geography_served.value: US national: Staffing franchise network across the United States

company_size.value: National staffing franchisor with an extensive office network serving local employers and broader corporate accounts

specialization.value: related lines: Temporary labor, commercial staffing, professional recruitment and executive search share employer relationships and recruitment capabilities

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Franchised staffing offices develop employer relationships and deliver recruitment services; direct sales: Staffing representatives sell directly to employers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Staffing operations face federal and state wage, employment, worker classification, workplace safety and workers' compensation rules, including Department of Labor and OSHA requirements

notes: The current geographic footprint and mix of franchise royalties versus directly earned staffing fees are uncertain without website material.
